name: Network Info
author: nertwork
description: Primary & public IP telemetry, live interface up/down speeds, compact & stacked bar modes, interactive throughput graph, gateway ping, DNS, VPNs, and per-app bandwidth.

barWidget.description: Primary & public IP telemetry, live interface up/down speeds, compact & stacked bar modes, interactive throughput graph, gateway ping, DNS, VPNs, and per-app bandwidth

schema.label: Bar Display Mode
schema.description: Information displayed on the status bar: both (private and public IP), private (primary interface IP), public (external IP), speed (network icon + live speeds), or icon (network icon only).

schema.label: Bar Speed Mode
schema.description: How live download/upload speeds are rendered on the bar: off, compact (single-line ↓768K ↑42K), stacked (two-line vertical ↓/↑ stack), active (dominant direction only), or full (↓ 768.0 KiB/s ↑ 42.0 KiB/s).

schema.label: Hide Speed When Idle
schema.description: Hide bar speed telemetry when both download and upload speeds are below 1 KiB/s.

schema.label: Throughput Interface Scope
schema.description: Measure throughput on the primary routed interface only or aggregate across all non-virtual interfaces.

schema.label: Show Throughput Graph
schema.description: Display the mirrored live download/upload throughput history chart in the popover panel.

schema.label: Show Per-App Activity
schema.description: Display top active processes with established TCP socket bandwidth in the popover panel.

schema.label: Throughput Graph Window (seconds)
schema.description: Time window in seconds for the live throughput graph (60 = 1m, 300 = 5m, 900 = 15m, 1800 = 30m).

schema.label: Speed Poll Interval (ms)
schema.description: Sampling interval in milliseconds for /proc/net/dev throughput calculation.
